shortDescription: Configures IBM Storage Protect Storage Agent

options.name: copygroup_destination
options.description: Storage pool name to which the LAN‑free backup will be written (e.g. “LANFREEPOOL”).

options.name: copygroup_domain
options.description: Policy domain under which the LAN‑free copy group resides (e.g. “LANFREEDOMAIN”).

options.name: copygroup_mngclass
options.description: Management class to use for the LAN‑free backup copy (e.g. “LANFREEMGMT”).

options.name: copygroup_policyset
options.description: Policy set name within the domain (e.g. “STANDARD”).

options.name: device
options.description: Device on the storage‐agent host (e.g. “/dev/sg0” or “/dev/st0”).

options.name: library
options.description: Name of the tape library as defined on the TSM server (e.g. MSLG3LIB). Used when defining the path to tell the server which library the drive belongs to.

options.name: lladdress
options.description: Port on which server will listen for lan free communication

options.name: max_attempts
options.description: Specifies the maximum number of times the module will retry the “validate lanfree” command. Because the Storage Agent process can take several seconds to become fully available, each retry is spaced by the configured delay to ensure the agent has time to connect before the final validation attempt.

options.name: node_name
options.description: Name of the TSM client node registered in the LAN‑free domain (e.g. “LANFREECLIENT”). Used by the validate operation to check that the node can backup via the storage agent.

options.name: password
options.description: Password for your IBM Storage Protect instance. If value not set, will try environment variable C(STORAGE_PROTECT_PASSWORD)

options.name: request_timeout
options.description: Specify the timeout Ansible should use in requests to the IBM Storage Protect host. Defaults to 10s, but this is handled by the shared module_utils code If value not set, will try environment variable C(STORAGE_PROTECT_REQUEST_TIMEOUT)

options.name: server_hl_address
options.description: High level address of the SP Server

options.name: server_name
options.description: SERVERNAME your IBM Storage Protect instance as specified in the dsm.sys. If value not set, will try environment variable C(STORAGE_PROTECT_SERVERNAME) If value not specified by any means, the value of C(local) will be used

options.name: server_password
options.description: Password for the server, to enable server to server communication

options.name: server_tcp_port
options.description: Port for the TCP/IP communication of server

options.name: stg_agent_hl_add
options.description: High-level address where client and storage agent are installed.

options.name: stg_agent_name
options.description: Name of the Storage Agent, which will be defined on the server

options.name: stg_agent_password
options.description: Password for the storage agent.

options.name: stg_agent_path_dest
options.description: Destination type for the SCSI path on the TSM server. Valid values are “drive” (for tape drives) or “library” (for the tape changer).

options.name: stg_agent_path_name
options.description: Name to assign to the path when defining the SCSI path on the TSM server. (for example “drv1”, “drv2”) is used in DEFINE PATH commands.

options.name: stg_agent_server_name
options.description: Name of the server where storage agent will be defined

options.name: stg_pool
options.description: The TSM server storage pool name where the LAN‑free backup will be written. Should match the pool defined in your copy group (e.g. “LANFREEPOOL”).

options.name: username
options.description: Username for your IBM Storage Protect instance. If value not set, will try environment variable C(STORAGE_PROTECT_USERNAME)

options.name: validate_lan_free
options.description: If true, run the TSM “VALIDATE LANFREE” command to verify the node/agent path is LAN‑free capable. Does not perform any configuration changes, only validation.
